meta.name: programmatic-seo
meta.description: Use when planning many similar pages from a template and a data set: choosing the pattern, deciding whether the data can carry it, and avoiding the thin-content failure that gets page sets deindexed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划批量相似页面的生成模式，避免内容过薄被降权
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用相同模板批量生成大量页面并保证它们在搜索中不被惩罚
copy.tagline_en: Plan bulk similar page patterns and avoid thin-content deindexing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate many pages from templates and keep them safe in search results

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会在你计划用模板和数据生成大量相似页面时,帮你评估数据价值、选择页面模式(如目录、对比等),并给出避免内容过薄、防止页面被搜索算法除索引的结构建议。
howto.when: 当你计划用同一个模板和数据集生成大量类似页面,或咨询页面模式选择、数据是否支撑、避免内容过薄时,会被触发。

say.text: 我们想用数据表生成500个城市页面,先评估是否可行。
say.note: Claude会按数据竞争力顺序帮你判断这条数据值不值得建页。

say.text: 我有产品集成数据,帮我选适合的页面模式。
say.note: 它会根据你的数据类型推荐模式,并提示常见的失败点。

say.text: 检查这套模板页是否有内容过薄风险,并给改进建议。
say.note: 它会逐项核对每页独有价值、标题唯一性等。

howto.what_en: It leads programmatic SEO planning: assess data defensibility, pick a pattern, ensure unique value, structure for indexing, monitor after launch. Outputs planning decisions and a checklist.
howto.when_en: Activates when you plan many similar pages from a template and a dataset, or ask about choosing a pattern, whether data can carry it, or avoiding thin content.

say_en.text: We want to generate 500 city pages from data; first assess viability.
say_en.note: Claude assesses data defensibility and advises next steps.

say_en.text: I have product integration data; help me pick a suitable page pattern.
say_en.note: Matches data type to pattern and lists failure modes.

say_en.text: Check this template set for thin-content risk and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: It audits unique value, unique titles, and linking per page.
